title: Neta Ji In Japan
definition: The strategic transition of Subhash Chandra Bose from Germany to Japan (1943) to lead the Indian National Army (INA) and the Azad Hind Government, marking the shift of the anti-colonial struggle to the Southeast Asian theater.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the 'Third Phase of National Movement', the role of external support in India's freedom struggle, and the geopolitical dynamics of WWII in Asia.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Neta Ji In Japan.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Rash Behari Bose's role in Japan
